items.mainDefect: The matcher inverts the comparison, rejecting a grant shortcut when it equals the expected value.

secondary.defect: The matcher reads substring(3, 5) instead of substring(4, 6), extracting the wrong characters for the grant shortcut.

items.mainDefect: Calling the newly abstract getShortcut() method on custom grant factories compiled against an older SPI causes AbstractMethodError during startup.

secondary.defect: A factory returning a null shortcut causes ConcurrentHashMap.put to throw NullPointerException instead of a descriptive validation error.

items.mainDefect: The decoder requires a two-character grant shortcut despite the SPI permitting longer shortcuts, breaking encode/decode round trips for custom grants.

secondary.defect: Token IDs containing a colon with a non-six-character prefix throw instead of receiving the UNKNOWN/legacy fallback used for colon-less IDs.
